title: Pin recovery after a refused fresh Base-only naming bind leaves authority Prepared
outcome: Previously published work has an explicit, tested recovery contract after a grant-free fresh naming SessionBind fails; unknown outcomes preserve canonical authority and never publish unproven state.
acceptance: A regression starts from published naming authority, attempts a fresh Base-only session bind that fails or is refused, and asserts the exact remaining authority phase, withheld evidence and canonical recovery outcome.
Any recovery change preserves unknown-outcome, owner/version, claim/store/runtime and exact acknowledged-image guards; it creates no turn grant or evidence association.
